1c1ba846efb29039.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صناع المراتب للصناعة عن مدير عمليات تشغيل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف المباشر على تخطيط وتنظيم وتشغيل المعدات المختلفة، مع ضمان توافر الموارد اللازمة لتحقيق أقصى قدر من الكفاءة والفعالية في العمليات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية لعمليات التشغيل. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال تخطيط وتنظيم تشغيل المعدات المختلفة. متابعة تنفيذ التعليمات المختلفة بما يتوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية. ضمان توافر كافة الموارد التقنية والبشرية التي تضمن سير العمليات بأكبر كفاءة وفعالية ممكنة. المساهمة الفعالة في إدارة وتوجيه وتقييم عمليات التطبيق للخطط والأهداف العامة. متابعة وإدارة وتوجيه الأنشطة المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات وضمان التطبيق الأمثل للأنظمة واللوائح. متابعة عمليات إصدار التراخيص والتصاريح بما يتوافق مع المعايير والشروط المعتمدة. المشاركة في مراجعة وتطوير الأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات المتبعة في مجالات تشغيل المعدات. مراجعة ودراسة الاحتياجات المتعلقة بالمعدات. متابعة عمليات إعداد وتحضير تقارير العمل والإنجاز وعرضها على الإدارة العليا. إحاطة الإدارة العليا بالتحديات والمستجدات المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات واستشارتهم في القضايا المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بعمليات التشغيل وإدارة المعدات. فهم عميق للخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية. القدرة على إدارة الموارد التقنية والبشرية بكفاءة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على متابعة وتنفيذ التعليمات واللوائح. مهارات تحليلية لإعداد التقارير ودراسة الاحتياجات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم التقارير والاستشارات للإدارة العليا. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق صناع المراتب للصناعة في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

1ca1f73f735b0ba9.description: About the Role Alfalak Electronic Equipment & Supplies Co. is seeking a Department Administrator to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves providing comprehensive administrative and technical support to a department of approximately 20 individuals. Key Responsibilities Manage office administration activities for the department, including proactive organization and maintaining office flow. Maintain and organize temporary office locations at Sadara or contractor offices. Ensure smooth onboarding for new employees by handling initial administrative activities. Raise small purchase orders for equipment, PPE, and other necessities. Issue formal communications to contractors as required. Organize departmental logistics, such as transportation and meeting conference rooms. Coordinate recognition events, lunches, and other departmental gatherings. Provide back-up cover for the department's document control technician. Assist in organizing training sessions for operators, engineers, and technicians. Provide second-line application support, identifying root causes, troubleshooting issues, and restoring proper operation. Escalate unresolved application issues to the appropriate solution provider. Provide Project, MOC, and Work Order support and technical assistance within the Engineering System Design Environment. Maintain document, data, and deliverable-format standards with discipline SMEs and ensure requirements are included in documents for internal and external engineering work. Coordinate with IT to improve engineering-application performance and maintain compatibility with corporate software and hardware infrastructure. Provide engineering-system access in accordance with intellectual-property requirements. Ensure compliance with EH&S guidelines, regulatory requirements, and permit requirements. Perform other job-related activities as requested by the immediate supervisor or manager. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Demonstrated ability to perform office administration activities efficiently. Experience with raising purchase orders and managing logistics. Familiarity with formal communication protocols. Required Skills Strong organizational and proactive planning skills. Ability to maintain professional and technical knowledge through continuous learning. Proficiency in application support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution. Attention to detail in maintaining document and data standards. Effective coordination skills with various departments, including IT. Understanding of EH&S guidelines and regulatory compliance. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail. The role requires matching department work hours, which may include some overtime. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

1cac26a2776d7898.description: About Richemont and Montblanc Richemont is seeking a Sales Associate for its Montblanc brand in Riyadh. Founded in 1906, Montblanc is a manufacturer of exclusive products including watches, jewelry, writing instruments, and leather goods, reflecting high standards in culture, quality, design, tradition, and craftsmanship. With over 25 subsidiaries and 600 boutiques, Montblanc maintains a global presence. Role Overview The Sales Associate will manage a specific sales channel, such as direct, online, or retail sales. This full-time role involves developing and implementing channel sales strategies aligned with overall business objectives. The associate will identify new business opportunities, set sales targets, and monitor performance metrics to ensure sales goals are met or exceeded. Additionally, the role includes managing relationships with channel partners, negotiating contracts, and providing necessary training and support. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement relationship management plans for complex potential customer accounts, identifying and building relationships with decision-makers and influencers. Set clear objectives for each sales call, deliver tailored presentations, gather and analyze information, and secure agreement on customer requirements. Cultivate a personal network within the business sector and represent the organization at industry events to obtain market intelligence and enhance visibility. Configure complex product-and-services solutions and contractual terms that meet customer needs, incorporating input from internal specialists. Present solutions to customer representatives and negotiate agreements within predefined commercial parameters, or review and authorize sales proposals from team members. Manage and deliver pricing and terms projects, negotiating with external strategic partners. Control specific segments of the organization's business performance metrics, ensuring strategic alignment with financial goals. Manage a portfolio of contracts and negotiate service-level agreements, planning, coordinating, and supervising related activities. Oversee the implementation and maintenance of the CRM system within the area of responsibility, identifying opportunities for system improvement. Implement and control compliance management for specific segments of the organization's external partners. Develop product education courses to meet identified needs, improving performance and meeting business requirements. Act as a subject matter expert in technology, policy, regulation, or operational management, maintaining external accreditations and an in-depth understanding of industry best practices. Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with the company's diversity and inclusion guidelines. Qualifications and Experience Master's Degree or equivalent level of education. Extensive experience (5-10 years) enabling the job holder to handle the majority of situations and advise others. Experience in general supervision of more junior colleagues. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The salary for this role will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

1c9540a4594691b6.description: About the Role alfanar is seeking a General Accountant to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves bookkeeping and monitoring accounting transactions, with a focus on ensuring accuracy and compliance across various financial areas. The position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 year of experience. Key Responsibilities Supervise supplier invoice processing and ensure 3-way matching accuracy. Verify invoices for tax and policy compliance. Oversee timely vendor payments and manage vendor inquiries. Monitor accruals, prepayments, and ensure expenses align with accounting periods. Reconcile accounts payable sub-ledger with vendor statements and resolve discrepancies. Oversee customer invoicing, ensuring accuracy and adherence to contracts. Evaluate customer creditworthiness and manage receivables to minimize bad debt. Implement collection procedures and resolve overdue payment issues. Reconcile customer accounts and analyze aging reports. Manage accounting for fixed assets, including acquisition, depreciation, and disposal. Ensure compliance with regulations and prevent inventory shrinkage. Track and verify company assets periodically. Oversee the general ledger and ensure accurate transaction recording. Reconcile balance sheet accounts and resolve discrepancies. Prepare financial statements per IFRS and assist with external audits. Support budget preparation, monitor financial performance, and identify risks. Improve accounting processes for efficiency and compliance with local regulations. Role Accountabilities HR Proficiency: Obtain updated soft and technical skills relevant to the job and develop a career path plan. Delivery: Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to schedules, utilizing resources effectively within cost and time constraints. Provide periodic reports on deviations and task execution. Problem-Solving: Resolve related problems that arise and escalate complex operational issues. Quality: Ensure quality requirements are met to develop effective quality control and processes, including specifications for products, processes, or related activities. Business Process Improvements: Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures, seeking automation opportunities where possible. Compliance: Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Health, Safety, and Environment: Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined work area to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high-quality products/services. Experience Required Candidates should have 0-5 year of experience in a relevant accounting role. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh.

1c823fbf30e434b1.description: About Chalhoub Group Chalhoub Group is a leading partner for luxury across the Middle East, operating over 600 stores and representing 300 brands with more than 65 years of experience. The group is evolving from a traditional distributor and retailer to a hybrid retailer, focusing on delivering luxury experiences to customers. The Role: Store Manager Chanel Beauty Chalhoub Group is seeking a Store Manager for Chanel Beauty in Makkah or Jeddah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves driving store business, building a loyal VIP customer base, managing the store team, and ensuring adherence to brand guidelines and store processes. The Store Manager acts as a brand representative, communicating its values and philosophy through all interactions. Key Responsibilities Define, execute, and monitor the store action plan to achieve sales targets and KPIs. Manage the customer database to build strong relationships and identify future selling opportunities. Stay informed on industry trends, products, and competitors, sharing feedback with relevant back-office stakeholders. Leverage both online and offline points of sale to drive business. Ensure all sales and operational policies and procedures are followed and maintained. Oversee the preparation and processing of e-commerce orders within set SLAs for time and quality. Utilize available technology tools (Clienteling app, OMS, Business Whatsapp) to support customer experience and ensure team proficiency. Ensure operating standards are followed, from stock replenishment to visual merchandising according to brand guidelines. Ensure compliance with legal, safety, security, retail operations, and HR guidelines, escalating issues as needed. Analyze historical traffic data to anticipate peak hours and ensure healthy floor coverage. Team Leadership and Customer Experience Provide a clear vision to the team regarding business and store objectives. Identify, recruit, develop, and retain strong talent within the team. Foster a positive work environment based on trust, respect, and fairness, and communicate employee feedback to leadership and HR. Coach team members, promoting a growth mindset through available learning tools and monitoring development plans. Ensure performance improvement plans are discussed and documented transparently. Develop an omnichannel mindset among the team, promoting physical and digital customer touchpoints and clienteling techniques, especially for VIPs. Recruit new clients and convert them into loyal VIP customers through excellent service and networking. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Ability to lead by example and represent the brand's values. Proficiency in managing customer relationships and driving sales targets. Experience in team leadership, development, and performance management. Understanding of omnichannel customer experience and operational excellence. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah or Jeddah. The role offers opportunities for professional growth through enriching experiences, learning and development, and exposure to different assignments within the role or through internal mobility.

1cebb9abb8016fdf.description: About MBRF MBRF is a company that impacts thousands of families globally by nourishing life through quality, innovation, and its dedicated workforce. This full-time R&D Analyst Factory role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The R&D Analyst Factory is responsible for coordinating and executing daily pilot plant activities, managing R&D documentation, and supporting product optimization and innovation initiatives. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Coordinate daily pilot plant activities, including trial scheduling, ingredient and packaging readiness, equipment availability, housekeeping, and safe execution. Execute product and packaging trials, record results, and assess technical feasibility, resource availability, costs, and compliance with business, quality, and regulatory requirements. Create and maintain R&D documentation, including Product and Process Specifications (PPS), packaging and ingredient specifications, trial records, and implementation follow-up. Prepare and dispatch customer samples, monitor Global Accounts products and agreed follow-up actions, and coordinate technical follow-up with new clients. Manage R&D inventory of ingredients, packaging materials, and finished-product samples, ensuring accurate receipt, identification, storage, stock records, availability, and expiry-date control. Support product optimization, portfolio maintenance, and quality actions; research and benchmark new product categories, technologies, and market opportunities. Collaborate with Procurement and suppliers on cost-saving and alternative-supplier initiatives, including ingredient and packaging trials and technical evaluations; support agreed ESG-related R&D activities. Prepare, support, and document sensory evaluations and consumer research, working with Commercial, Marketing, Category, Brand, Innovation, Production, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, customers, and technical suppliers to deliver agreed project milestones. Experience and Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Environment and Benefits MBRF offers a global, collaborative, and dynamic working environment. The company maintains a strong corporate culture with commitments to customers, employees, and the environment. Employees can expect vertical, horizontal, and cross-functional growth opportunities, along with a competitive compensation package. Location This position is located in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

1c5b01e835c97757.description: مطلوب ممثل خدمة عملاء (لتطبيق B8ak) عن الوظيفة: تقديم دعم سريع ومباشر لمستخدمي التطبيق ومزودي الخدمة، وحل أي مشكلات تواجههم لضمان تجربة ممتازة. المهام الأساسية: الرد على الاستفسارات عبر الشات، الهاتف، والإيميل. مساعدة العملاء في استخدام التطبيق والطلبات والمدفوعات. متابعة الطلبات المباشرة وحل مشكلات التأخير أو الإلغاء. التنسيق مع فريق التشغيل وحل الشكاوى بحرفية. تسجيل الشكاوى والملاحظات في نظام الـ CRM. المؤهلات المطلوبة: شهادة دبلوم أو بكالوريوس. إتقان اللغتين العربية والإنجليزية. إلمام جيد باستخدام تطبيقات الموبايل وأنظمة الـ CRM. القدرة على العمل بنظام الشفتات المرنة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وسرعة في حل المشكلات.

1c1500e6d5e307f4.description: About the Role SKM Air Conditioning is seeking an Estimation Engineer to join their team in Makkah, with responsibilities covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves preparing, reviewing, and submitting technical and commercial proposals for after-sales service contracts, retrofit projects, spare parts, maintenance agreements, and repair works. The Estimation Engineer will coordinate closely with customers, sales teams, service operations, procurement, and finance to develop competitive and profitable bids. Key Responsibilities Review RFQs, tenders, and customer inquiries related to after-sales services. Prepare technical and commercial quotations for Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC), Comprehensive Maintenance Contracts (CMC), retrofit and modernization projects, spare parts supply, repairs and service works, and energy efficiency and upgrade solutions. Analyze customer requirements, specifications, and project scope. Conduct site surveys as required to assess equipment conditions and service requirements. Coordinate with service operations, engineering, procurement, and suppliers to obtain technical and commercial inputs. Prepare cost estimations, pricing calculations, and profit margin analysis. Develop technical proposals, compliance statements, and bid documentation. Negotiate with suppliers and subcontractors to obtain competitive pricing. Ensure bids comply with company policies, customer requirements, and contractual terms. Maintain records of quotations, tender submissions, and bid status. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 3-8 years of experience in HVAC After Sales, Service Sales, Estimation, or Bid Engineering. Strong understanding of HVAC systems, including Chillers, AHUs, FCUs, VRF Systems, Package Units, and Cooling Towers. Experience in preparing service and maintenance contract proposals. Knowledge of tendering procedures and contract management. Proficiency in MS Office, ERP systems, and estimation software. Preferred Experience Experience with HVAC manufacturers or service companies such as Carrier, Trane, Johnson Controls, Daikin, SKM, Zamil, or similar. GCC/UAE/KSA market exposure. Knowledge of maintenance contracts, retrofit projects, and HVAC service operations. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role requires coordination across various internal departments and external stakeholders. Application Process Candidates meeting the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

1c323e9f38fce54e.description: About the Role Jasara Program Management Company is seeking a Senior Logistics Security and Interface Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing and coordinating logistics operations, site security, and interface management for large-scale construction and engineering projects. The position requires extensive hands-on site experience, preferably within major infrastructure, mixed-use, industrial, or other complex development projects. Role Purpose The Senior Logistics Security and Interface Manager will provide strong leadership and coordination to ensure the efficient movement of resources, materials, equipment, and personnel. This includes maintaining robust site security arrangements and fostering effective coordination among contractors, consultants, project stakeholders, and relevant authorities to support project progress. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and oversee comprehensive site logistics plans for large-scale construction and engineering projects. Manage site access, traffic management, transportation routes, material deliveries, storage, laydown areas, and heavy equipment movements. Coordinate logistics requirements with construction teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and project management consultants. Ensure efficient utilization of site resources and minimize logistical constraints impacting construction progress. Identify potential logistical risks and implement mitigation measures to maintain uninterrupted site operations. Monitor logistics performance and ensure compliance with project requirements, applicable regulations, and safety standards. Develop and implement project-wide security strategies, policies, and procedures to safeguard personnel, assets, equipment, and project facilities. Oversee site security operations, including access control, perimeter security, surveillance, visitor management, and security personnel. Coordinate with security contractors, local authorities, emergency response teams, and other relevant stakeholders. Conduct security risk assessments and implement appropriate preventive and contingency measures. Investigate security incidents and ensure timely reporting, documentation, and corrective actions. Ensure security arrangements align with project requirements and applicable local regulations. Lead and coordinate interfaces between construction contractors, engineering consultants, project management teams, utility providers, government entities, and other stakeholders. Identify, monitor, and resolve physical, operational, logistical, and organizational interface issues across project packages. Establish effective interface coordination procedures, communication protocols, and reporting mechanisms. Facilitate interface meetings and ensure timely resolution of issues affecting construction activities and project delivery. Maintain interface registers, action trackers, risk logs, and coordination plans. Proactively identify potential conflicts between contractors, construction activities, and project infrastructure to avoid delays and disruptions. Leadership and Reporting Provide strategic direction and leadership to logistics, security, and interface teams. Monitor departmental performance against project schedules, milestones, and operational objectives. Prepare management reports, performance dashboards, risk assessments, and progress updates. Work closely with the Project Director, Construction Director, and other senior project stakeholders to ensure seamless project execution. Drive continuous improvement in logistics efficiency, security management, and interface coordination. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in logistics, security, and interface management. Extensive hands-on site experience, preferably within major infrastructure, mixed-use, industrial, or other complex development projects. Demonstrated leadership and coordination capabilities. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

1c3ccab038a1acd6.description: About the Role Guthmi Group is seeking a Banks Accountant to join their team in Jeddah or Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position suitable for professionals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on managing and monitoring the company's banking operations and financial transactions. Key Responsibilities Monitor and follow up on daily bank balances to ensure accuracy and liquidity. Open and manage company bank accounts, ensuring compliance with internal policies and banking regulations. Track and monitor all bank account transactions, verifying their accuracy and proper classification. Verify and approve payment requests, ensuring adherence to established budgets and company policies. Process payments efficiently using various methods, including cheques, bank transfers, and cash. Prepare and submit transfer and payment orders as required. Communicate regularly with banks to discuss financial services, resolve issues, and follow up on transactions. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience in accounting or banking operations. Strong understanding of banking procedures and financial transaction processing. Ability to ensure accuracy and compliance in all financial activities. Work Environment and Location This full-time position is based in either Jeddah or Makkah, Makkah region, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within the finance department of Guthmi Group, contributing to the efficient management of the company's financial resources. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

1c89c9311893f0c3.description: About Alfanar Projects Alfanar Construction operates as an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company, holding a Grade I contractor classification from the Government of Saudi Arabia. The company has demonstrated consistent growth, establishing itself as a prominent EPC contractor across the Energy, Infrastructure, and Engineering Services sectors within Saudi Arabia. Supported by specialized service units, Alfanar Construction is committed to delivering timely and appropriate solutions to clients, adhering to international standards. Core EPC activities include Power and Water Projects, Transmission and Distribution Projects, Building Construction (Industrial & Commercial) Projects, and Electro-Mechanical projects. The Role: Site Civil Engineer Alfanar Projects is seeking a Site Civil Engineer to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires an experienced professional to manage and oversee civil engineering activities on site, ensuring projects are executed efficiently and in compliance with quality and safety standards. The role involves leadership, team development, and operational accountability. Key Responsibilities Train subordinates and build an effective team to ensure efficient work execution. Provide leadership, coaching, and clear direction to subordinates across all aspects of their work. Delegate tasks and assignments appropriately to subordinates. Ensure equitable distribution of tasks to maintain team morale and motivation. Execute planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time parameters. Prepare periodic reports detailing deviations and the execution status of planned tasks. Resolve emerging problems and escalate complex operational issues as necessary. Ensure adherence to quality requirements, developing effective quality control measures and processes, including specifications for products, processes, or related activities. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures, actively seeking automation opportunities. Comply with all relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined work area to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and the delivery of high-quality products/services. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in civil engineering, preferably within an EPC environment. Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a team. Strong understanding of quality control processes and international standards. Proficiency in preparing detailed reports and managing project schedules. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

1c9f2f41a63dc40e.description: About the Role alfanar is seeking a Legal Counsel, Contracts to provide day-to-day legal support for its EPC and project development businesses. This full-time role involves working under the guidance of the Senior Legal Counsel and General Counsel, focusing on renewable energy, power, water, and infrastructure projects across Saudi Arabia and international markets. Key Responsibilities Lead legal support for EPC and development tenders, including RFPs, contract reviews, qualifications, deviations, clarifications, risk registers, and bid approvals. Draft, review, and negotiate EPC, EP, construction, turnkey, supply, and O&M contracts for power, water, renewable energy, transmission, distribution, and industrial projects, utilizing FIDIC and bespoke forms. Advise on risk allocation, guarantees, liquidated damages, liability, indemnities, warranties, insurance, suspension, and termination clauses. Negotiate subcontracts, supply, consortium, JV, and teaming agreements, ensuring alignment with main contracts. Support contract administration, including notices, variations, EOT, delays, payments, commissioning, close-out, and remedies. Review bonds and parent company guarantees, including calls and defenses. Support development and investment in renewable energy, power, water, and infrastructure from origination to financial close. Draft and negotiate joint development, JV, shareholders', consortium, cooperation, and MoU agreements. Advise on PPAs, water purchase, implementation, concession, land, lease, grid connection, and government support agreements. Support project financing and negotiate financing and security documents with finance teams and external counsel. Advise on construction claims, contractual disputes, arbitration, and litigation. Advise on Saudi and international laws covering procurement, local content, Saudization, contractor classification, licensing, and foreign investment. Project Development and Finance Support The role involves assisting with project structuring, acquisitions, divestments, due diligence, and corporate transactions. This includes identifying legal risks and preparing investment committee inputs. Additionally, the Legal Counsel will review loan and direct agreements, equity contributions, sponsor support, guarantees, and security packages, while supporting lender due diligence and fulfillment of conditions precedent. Advice on bankability and alignment of project, EPC, and financing agreements is also a key aspect. Claims Management and Dispute Resolution Responsibilities include supporting notices and EOT, variation, delay, disruption, and other claims. The Legal Counsel will assess claims, counterclaims, and exposure, recommending commercial resolutions. This involves leading negotiations, settlements, and dispute avoidance, as well as coordinating external counsel, technical and quantum experts, and claims consultants to enforce contractual rights and recover outstanding payments. Corporate, Regulatory, and Compliance The Legal Counsel will support corporate structuring, JVs, project companies, and branches. This includes preparing corporate approvals, board resolutions, powers of attorney, and related documents. The role also involves supporting anti-bribery, sanctions, and export control compliance, as well as identifying regulatory risks and advising on mitigation strategies. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant legal experience.

1c050b5f51fcd613.description: About Qiddiya and the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Senior Public Art Program Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves leading the planning, delivery, and installation of the QPAC public art program, ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders and contributing to Qiddiya’s cultural objectives. The position requires 7-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead the planning, delivery, and installation of the QPAC public art program, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya’s cultural objectives. Manage the complete artwork lifecycle, from artist selection and contractual agreements through commissioning, design development, fabrication, installation, and long-term stewardship. Develop artist briefs that reflect QPAC’s curatorial vision, cultural narrative, architectural context, and community considerations. Oversee artist shortlisting, evaluation, selection, commissioning, procurement, contracting, payment terms, appointment, and KPI management. Coordinate with artists, studio facilities, workshops, materials, galleries, curators, architects, engineers, consultants, fabricators, and contractors. Collaborate closely with QIC departments, committees, and assets, as well as external groups including government stakeholders and partners. Lead concept and design-development reviews, setting key performance dates and indicators to ensure artistic intent is translated into technically feasible and commercially deliverable solutions. Oversee artwork integration, fabrication, materials, logistics, installation, quality assurance, and final handover processes. Manage program schedules, budgets, licensing, contracts, variations, risks, and progress reporting, including government approvals. Ensure compliance with safety, technical, regulatory, durability, maintenance, sustainability goals, and asset-stewardship requirements. Prepare and present recommendations to the Art Committee, evaluate materials, and maintain approval records for stakeholders. Maintain accurate and traceable program documentation using Qiddiya-approved document-management systems. Support cultural partnerships, community engagement, and the integration of public art within QPAC to enhance customer experience. 1c59946646e0911f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة السعودية ريسبونس بلس للخدمات الطبية عن كاتب تأمين للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، ويُعنى بمعالجة طلبات بوالص التأمين، وضمان دقة المعلومات، وإدارة سجلات التأمين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية التواصل مع حاملي بوالص التأمين للتحقق من دقة واكتمال المعلومات في نماذج المطالبات والطلبات والمستندات ذات الصلة. مراجعة البيانات والمستندات المقدمة من حاملي بوالص التأمين ووكلاء التأمين والتحقق من صحتها، بما في ذلك طلبات التأمين الأصلية لتحديد التغييرات اللازمة. إعداد طلبات بوالص التأمين وإلغائها، ونماذج مطالبات التأمين، ونماذج الأعمال التجارية والحكومية، وغيرها من المستندات. حساب أقساط التأمين الأساسية، والمبالغ المستردة، والعمولات، والتسويات، ومتطلبات الاحتياطي الجديدة باستخدام الأدوات القياسية، مع ضمان حساب الأقساط والمعدلات بشكل صحيح. إعداد فواتير سداد الأقساط، والتأكد من سداد الدفعات، وتحصيل الأقساط الأولية وإصدار الإيصالات. إجراء تحقيقات محدودة حول المطالبات ومعالجة المدفوعات بعد التصديق عليها. حفظ سجلات التأمين بشكل دقيق ومنظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات والمستندات بدقة عالية. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتفاعل مع حاملي بوالص التأمين والوكلاء. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الشركة السعودية ريسبونس بلس للخدمات الطبية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

1cc15564feca02c2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دريم السعودية لتقديم الوجبات عن اخصائي دعم فني للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان الأداء الأمثل للأجهزة والأنظمة التقنية داخل المؤسسة، وتقديم الدعم الفني اللازم للمستخدمين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع المواصفات الفنية للأجهزة الجديدة، واستلامها والتأكد من مطابقتها للمعايير المطلوبة. توثيق جميع الأجهزة وملحقاتها في المؤسسة، وتسجيل المشاكل اليومية التي تطرأ عليها. إجراء الصيانة الدورية والوقائية لضمان استمرارية عمل الأجهزة بكفاءة. تقديم الدعم الفني للمستخدمين، والإجابة عن استفساراتهم المتعلقة بالمشاكل التقنية، وتقديم الحلول الممكنة أو توجيههم إلى الجهات المختصة. التحقق من حالة الأنظمة والتأكد من احتوائها على البرامج الأساسية مثل نظم التشغيل، وتحويل الأعطال الكبيرة إلى الموردين أو مسؤولي الصيانة. إعداد التقارير الفنية الدورية، والعمل على تطوير أساليب العمل باستخدام أحدث التقنيات المتاحة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الدعم الفني أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تحديد المواصفات الفنية للأجهزة والتحقق من جودتها. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية والدورية للأجهزة والأنظمة. مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات وتقديم الدعم للمستخدمين. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل اخصائي الدعم الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان سير العمليات التقنية بسلاسة وفعالية. تقديم الطلبات الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم.

1cd5dc3b6f38d555.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رتاج الخير الأهلية عن معلم ابتدائي للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي في تيماء، تبوك. يركز هذا الدور على تدريس طلاب المرحلة الابتدائية مجموعة متنوعة من المواد الأساسية، مع التركيز على تطوير المهارات الأكاديمية والاجتماعية للطلاب. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتماشى مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس. تدريس الطلاب في مجالات القراءة والكتابة واللغات والرياضيات والعلوم والفنون والتربية البدنية والموسيقى وغيرها من المواد الابتدائية. تقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات، وتحديد الواجبات، وتنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية. إدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم داخل البيئة الصفية لضمان بيئة تعليمية إيجابية. تقييم تقدم الطلاب ونموهم الأكاديمي والاجتماعي بشكل دوري. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء والسلوك، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى دعم إضافي وتوفير الطرق اللازمة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. حضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق الفعال مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنوات في مجال تدريس المرحلة الابتدائية. القدرة على تدريس عدة موضوعات أساسية للمرحلة الابتدائية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتفاعل مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بالعمل بدوام كامل. القدرة على العمل في تيماء، تبوك. الالتزام بالمعايير الأكاديمية والتربوية للمدرسة. بيئة العمل يعمل المعلم الابتدائي ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في شركة رتاج الخير الأهلية، حيث يتعاون مع فريق من المعلمين والإداريين لتقديم أفضل تجربة تعليمية للطلاب. تقع الوظيفة في مدينة تيماء بمنطقة تبوك. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

Experience in managing complex disputes, claims and litigations, including developing legal strategies, coordinating with external counsel and advising the business on risk and resolution options. 1c9ed14b83b61f60.description: The Warehouse Chemist is responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and efficient management of chemicals and dangerous goods within warehouse operations.
